text: An investment of $1,500,000 in Senior Debt is recommended. The proposed investment will not be advanced unless it meets risk/reward and Greenhouse Gas (GHG) impact expectations, and until appropriate terms, including security and other conditions, are approved by the Investment Committee.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved an investment of $1,500,000, through a Private Equity (PE) Limited Partnership (LP) as set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (October 31, 2018) from the Vice President, Impact Investing, and subject to a final review of the transaction by the Investment Committee including a review of the "Conditions Precedent to Advance". 2. Directed that the information in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (October 31, 2018) from the Vice President, Impact Investing remain confidential as it relates to the security of property belonging to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund (TAF); commercial and financial information, supplied in confidence to Toronto Atmospheric Fund, if disclosed, could reasonably be expected to prejudice significantly the competitive position or interfere significantly with the contractual or other…
